maddeler.e:
أستقر (form X)
# أَسْتَقِرُّ (ʔastaqirru) /ʔas.ta.qir.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقَرَّ (istaqarra)
# أَسْتَقِرَّ (ʔastaqirra) /ʔas.ta.qir.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقَرَّ (istaqarra)
# أَسْتَقِرِّ (ʔastaqirri) /ʔas.ta.qir.ri/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَقَرَّ (istaqarra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
